context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 31 verified the permissions modal campaign filtering fix. Key findings: 1) openEditModal() in permissions.blade.php now filters allCampaigns by userOperator using: filteredCampaigns = allCampaigns.filter(c => c.store_name === userOperator). 2) Mohamed Slama (operator: Club Privilèges By Pluxee) sees only 3 Pluxee campaigns. 3) Users with operators that have no matching campaigns (Sub-Stores, Partnership, Timwe) see 'Aucune campagne disponible pour [operator]' message. 4) Campaign access update works - tested restriction (1 campaign assigned) and full access restore. 5) Audit log at /admin/audit-logs captures all permission changes with before/after campaign states. 6) Journal d'Audit link in header navigates correctly.
